rw_frontrangeflex_harness_26.name: Ruffwear Front Range Flex Harness (2026 SS)

• To maintain the harness, secure all fasteners before washing. Use cold water on a gentle cycle with mild detergent. Air dry the product after cleaning.

Use
• Use the buckles for easy on and off.
• Attach the leash to the back V-ring or the chest webbing.

Important information
• For dogs that pull strongly, use the chest leash attachment point to redirect them.

• Side-release buckles for easy on/off

• Available in two lengths: 5.5-7 ft (1.7-2.1 m) or 7.3-11 ft (2.2-3.4 m). The waist strap adjusts up to 48 in (122 cm), and the webbing width is 1 in (25 mm).

Care
• Clean by hand washing with mild detergent and air drying to maintain the product's condition.

Features
• Aluminum Uniloop reinforced side-release buckle for easy adjustment when worn around the waist

Use
• Adjust when worn around the waist using the side-release buckle
• Attach pickup bags or small leash accessories to the accessory loop
